notes: Corrected: יָד was marked unrepresented beside מַלֹּאות holding the whole of consecrate. Rule 30 forbids that where a single English word carries every morpheme's sense in a fixed contiguous expression, and rule 22's first sentence governs an element the ASV left unwritten rather than one whose sense stands inside a fused word. The two now share one unit headed on מַלֹּאות, the suffix keeping its own himself under rule 18. This is the same treatment the chapter gives נָתְנוּ יָד → submitted themselves at 1CH.29.24.
מִתְנַדֵּב is headed on offereth as the lexical predicate; heading on willingly as a light-verb complement was available but offereth is not a light verb.
